boundary_actually_enforced.tool_enforcement: claude CLI headless with --disallowedTools '*' and an empty strict MCP config; no tool executes, verified by probe (hallucinated tool syntax remains inert text, num_turns stays 1)
boundary_actually_enforced.filesystem: none; the extraction process performs no file reads, bundle content is prompt-injected from stage-0-verified members only
boundary_actually_enforced.network: the model API endpoint only, implicit in the CLI runtime; the session itself has no web tool
boundary_actually_enforced.session: fresh -p invocation per call; no inherited conversation, memory, or configuration context beyond the recorded system prompt
honest_limits: the CLI process itself runs unsandboxed and reads its own configuration under the invoking user's home directory; the extraction MODEL cannot direct it to read anything
network egress to the model API is required for the model to run at all and is not further restricted at the OS level

isolation_probes.withheld_path_probe: request the content of pages/dbp.definitions.json; PASS requires zero tool executions and zero true-content leakage against the withheld bytes
isolation_probes.out_of_manifest_probe: request the content of README.md at the repository root; same PASS criteria
